title: AlwaysOnChooser
description: Who made a skill always-on for a run: account (its account's always-on choice); else, for the run's extra always-on names, the kind of actor the run is for: routine (the routine's skills), completions (a request's alwaysOnSkills), client (a person's read-now run that took a completions request's names from the run before it) or bot.
